summary: The Moon's full aspect on the lagna (Moon in the 7th) gives a gentle, courteous and fortunate nature, wealth, gains from water-related trade and a strong influence of women in one's life.
common_outcomes: courteous and soft-natured (Saravali 34.1-7)
fortunate and wealthy (Saravali 34.1-7)
gains through water-born goods (Saravali 34.1-7)
under the influence of women (Saravali 34.1-7)
better proportion and delicacy of body (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
rare_outcomes: Lagna in a decanate of Mercury aspected by the Moon from an angle: even one of royal birth turns to craft work (Saravali 34.71).

The Moon cannot aspect itself; on aspects of the Moon on the Sun Saravali ch. 22 gives sign-wise results, e.g. Sun in Cancer aspected by the Moon: a king or equal to a king (22.28-33); Sun in Leo aspected by the Moon: a scholar (22.36-41).

by_area.finance: Wealthy; trade in water-born or liquid goods (Saravali 34.1-7).
by_area.health: Better bodily proportion (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).
by_area.relationships: Women strongly shape the native's choices (Saravali 34.1-7).

strengtheners: Waxing Moon increases the good (Trailokya Prakasa via Santhanam).
Saravali 34.8: Cancer lagna aspected by its own lord gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Two or more planets aspecting the lagna give happiness and wealth (Saravali 34.10-11).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon reduces the effects (Trailokya Prakasa via Santhanam).
lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon casts only the 7th aspect in full, from the 7th house onto the lagna. For Cancer lagna it is the lagna lord's own aspect.

source_views.view: Sun in Cancer aspected by the Moon: king or equal; Sun in Leo aspected by the Moon: a scholar.

source_views.view: A house occupied or aspected by the Moon gains good effects if the Moon is waxing; otherwise its effects diminish.

source_views.view: The Moon counts as a natural benefic when bright (waxing); temporal benefic status comes from house rulership.

Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

disagreements: Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. phrasing_guidance: Present as warmth, popularity and comfort; mention emotional dependence on others gently. Describe the Moon's aspect as care, emotion, the public and the mother touching that house; say it works better when the Moon is bright (waxing).

summary: In Saravali the Moon's aspect on the 2nd is a caution for wealth: a weak Moon aspecting a 2nd already holding malefics deepens loss, and the Moon's aspect on Mercury in the 2nd costs earned wealth; Raman reads the Moon's link with Mercury in the 2nd more kindly.
common_outcomes: a weak (waning) Moon aspecting the 2nd intensifies the loss shown by Mars, Saturn and the Sun there (Saravali 34.15-20)
Mercury in the 2nd aspected by the Moon: the wealth earned is lost (Saravali 34.15-20)
rare_outcomes: Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5: one loses wealth if Mercury aspected by the Moon joins the Jupiter-in-2nd combination; but the Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury favours earning by one's own effort.

by_area.finance: Earned wealth can slip away when the Moon aspects Mercury in the 2nd, and a weak Moon worsens malefic damage to the 2nd (Saravali 34.15-20).

strengtheners: A waxing Moon is not named as harmful here; the rules stress the weak Moon (Saravali 34.15-20).
lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon aspects the 2nd from the 8th house.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.
